ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Partner_Tanium_Cloud",
( OR(ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'Partner Internal'), ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'IR')) && (Duration__c < 1 || Duration__c > 120) )
||
( ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'MSP End User') && (Duration__c < 1 || Duration__c > 60) )
||
( ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c , 'Assessment') && (Duration__c < 1 || Duration__c > 90) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Partner: Tanium Cloud, # days must be Between 1 and 120 for Partner Internal and IR, 1-90 days for Assessment and1-60 days for MSP End User.
